rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
SET @prov5 := (SELECT hoscode FROM sys_config c INNER JOIN chospital h ON c.provincecode=h.provcode AND h.hostype in(1));
SET @yearpop:=(SELECT max(b_year) FROM k_mental_pop WHERE cat_id ='f10');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_mental_f10','result5','INT(10) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_mental_f10','result6','INT(10) DEFAULT 0 ');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_mental_f10(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	pop int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,	
	k varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
	target int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result1 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result2 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result3 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result4 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result5 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	result6 int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_mental_f10 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_mental_f10
(
SELECT
@id,@prov5,CONCAT(@prov_c,'000000') areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,p.pop,ROUND(p.k,3),pop_k
,r1.result1 ,r2.result2
,r3.result3,r4.result4
,r5.result5,r6.result6
FROM
(SELECT 
p.prov_code,p.pop,p.k,p.pop_k
FROM k_mental_pop p
WHERE p.prov_code in(@prov_c) AND cat_id IN('f10') AND b_year IN(@yearpop)
) p , 

(SELECT
SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,2) prov_code,IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid),0) as result1
FROM tmp_f10 f  
WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >=18 AND SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,2)  in(@prov_c)
AND diag_date_serv < @start_d
GROUP BY SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,2) 
) r1 ,
(SELECT @prov_c,COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as result2
FROM tmp_f10 f  
WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >=18 AND diag_date_serv < @start_d
AND (LENGTH(TRIM(f.final_addr)) =0 OR ISNULL(f.final_addr))
) r2 ,
(SELECT
@prov_c,IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid),0) as result3
FROM tmp_f10 f  
WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >=18 AND SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,2)  in(@prov_c)
AND diag_date_serv BETWEEN  @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,2) 
) r3 ,
(SELECT @prov_c,COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as result4
FROM tmp_f10 f  
WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >=18 AND diag_date_serv BETWEEN  @start_d AND @end_d
AND (LENGTH(TRIM(f.final_addr)) =0 OR ISNULL(f.final_addr))
) r4 ,
(SELECT
provcode,COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as result5
FROM
tmp_f10 f INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.diag_hospcode=h.hoscode 
WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >=18 
AND diag_date_serv < @start_d
GROUP BY h.provcode
) r5 ,
(SELECT
provcode,COUNT(DISTINCT f.cid) as result6
FROM
tmp_f10 f INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.diag_hospcode=h.hoscode 
WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >=18 
AND diag_date_serv  BETWEEN  @start_d AND @end_d
GROUP BY h.provcode
) r6);

rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 );
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx (PRIMARY KEY (diag_hospcode,diag_pid)) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE  AS
SELECT
h.hoscode,h.hosname,f.*
FROM
tmp_f10 f 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.diag_hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) 
WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >= 18  
{where} ;

INSERT IGNORE INTO tx(
SELECT  
v.hoscode,v.hosname,f.*
FROM 
tmp_f10 f 
INNER JOIN (SELECT hospcode,villcode,hoscode,h.hosname 
										FROM cvillage_hosp v INNER JOIN chospital h ON v.hospcode=h.hoscode {where}
										AND LENGTH(villcode)=8	GROUP BY SUBSTR(villcode,1,6) 
										) v 	ON SUBSTR(v.villcode,1,6)=SUBSTR(f.final_addr,1,6) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,f.birth,f.diag_date_serv) >=18
);

SELECT
d.hoscode,d.hosname,d.CID,d.name,d.lname,d.birth,d.sex,d.nation,d.diag_hospcode,d.diag_pid,d.diag_date_serv
,d.diag_diagcode,d.home_addr,d.addr_addr,d.moi_addr,d.hos_addr,source,d.final_addr
FROM tx d
